architecture.adapter_policy: Concrete policy and secret engines are adapter implementations only; cloud-intelligence targets owned ports and cloud substrate services.
architecture.gateway_deployment_target: Kubernetes gateway Deployment handles hot-path request routing.
architecture.worker_controller_target: Workers/controllers reconcile routes, inventory, credentials, analytics, circuit breakers, parity, drift, and compatibility canaries.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Exposes one endpoint for Anthropic-compatible and OpenAI-compatible clients; upstream local default is treated as source behavior, not an Oyatie deployment model.
capabilities.target_capability: Expose one tenant-scoped Kubernetes gateway Service/Ingress with Anthropic Messages and OpenAI-compatible routes; require cloud authn/authz/mTLS/API-key policy at the edge.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Anthropic Messages endpoint: `POST /v1/messages`; thin count-tokens path: `/v1/messages/count_tokens`; legacy `/v1/complete` allowlist.
capabilities.target_capability: Implement `/v1/messages`, `/v1/messages/count_tokens`, legacy allowlist policy, and explicit deprecation/compat handling.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: OpenAI Chat Completions endpoint: `POST /v1/chat/completions`, with byte-for-byte pass-through when routed to OpenAI-compatible backends.
capabilities.target_capability: Implement `/v1/chat/completions` as a first-class OpenAI-compatible API, with no accidental Anthropic-only coupling.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: `GET /v1/models` reflects live Claude models plus shortcuts (`fable`, `opus`, `sonnet`, `haiku`, `[1m]`) and OpenAI-compatible models when configured.
capabilities.target_capability: Implement provider-aware, tenant-aware model inventory with aliases and capability tags.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Health/status/admin/observability routes: `/health`, `/status`, `/accounts`, `/analytics`, `/analytics/stream`, `/admin/resume`.
capabilities.target_capability: Keep existing `/healthz`, `/livez`, `/readyz`, `/metrics`; add stable admin equivalents with OpenAPI contracts and authz.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Programmatic JS API exports proxy startup, OAuth, pool, accounts, analytics, backend functions.
capabilities.target_capability: Provide Rust crate-level APIs and generated gRPC/admin client equivalents, not only a binary.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Protocol + model-name matrix decides backend: Anthropic requests with Claude/Fable aliases use Claude subscription backend; Anthropic requests with `gpt`/`llama` use OpenAI-compatible translation; OpenAI requests with `gpt`/`o*` pass to OpenAI-compatible backend; OpenAI requests with `claude` translate to Anthropic.
capabilities.target_capability: Implement deterministic `ModelRouter`: explicit provider prefix > route policy > protocol/model classifier > tenant default.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Provider prefixes force backend: `openai:`, `groq:`, `openrouter:`, `local:`, `compat:` to OpenAI-compatible; `claude:`, `anthropic:` to Claude subscription.
capabilities.target_capability: Add extensible `ProviderPrefixRegistry` and policy validation; support current external reference prefixes plus Oyatie references (Gemini, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, vLLM, SGLang, etc.).

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Claude model aliases and shortcuts: fable, fable1m, opus, opus47/46, opus1m, sonnet, sonnet1m, haiku; `[1m]` capability tags.
capabilities.target_capability: Define typed model aliases/capabilities; return canonical model in upstream request and preserve client-visible compatibility behavior.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Optional model override via external command/config behavior and effort/max-token handling.
capabilities.target_capability: Model override must be declarative, tenant-scoped, audited, and policy-authorized through CRD/config/admin API; effort suffixes/capabilities are normalized before routing.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: One OpenAI-compatible backend configured at a time in pinned source reference, supporting OpenAI/OpenRouter/Groq/LiteLLM/Ollama/etc.
capabilities.target_capability: Superset: multiple named backends per tenant/namespace with weighted fallback, health, quotas, and policy.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Backend management behavior from the external command surface: list/add/remove named OpenAI-compatible backends, safe backend names, and operator backend view.
capabilities.target_capability: Superset as authenticated Kubernetes/API ProviderBackend CRUD/admission with owned secret-provider handles, route-controller status, and read-only operator views.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: pinned source reference bypasses transformations for OpenAI-compatible backend pass-through except auth/base-url/header rewrite.
capabilities.target_capability: Preserve pass-through semantics unless a declared adapter requires transformation; test body/header streaming invariants.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Anthropic ↔ OpenAI request/response translation, including streaming tool-use deltas and non-streaming usage.
capabilities.target_capability: Implement typed translation layer with golden fixtures for every supported direction; stream chunks without buffering full responses.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Claude Code template replay and live capture to maintain provider wire shape.
capabilities.target_capability: Superset with versioned `WireProfile` artifacts, signed captures, and worker-run drift probes per provider.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Request body key order, header order/static CC headers, beta header filtering, model-conditional betas, and template invariants are guarded by tests.
capabilities.target_capability: Encode provider-specific wire profiles and test them as contracts; avoid ad-hoc serializer behavior in hot path.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: TLS/runtime fingerprint behavior with strict TLS option and Bun fingerprinting.
capabilities.target_capability: Decide per provider whether transport fingerprinting is allowed/compliant; if allowed, isolate in provider adapter and verify by integration tests.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Behavioral timing: pacing, jitter, think-time, session-start delay, stealth mode.
capabilities.target_capability: Make behavioral pacing explicit route policy, default off unless compliance approves; record latency budget impact.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Stream-drain-on-close option to mimic clients that read SSE to EOF.
capabilities.target_capability: Add stream lifecycle policy and tests for disconnect/drain/no-drain cost behavior.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Session ID lifecycle: sticky IDs, rotation by idle/max-age/jitter, per-client mode.
capabilities.target_capability: Implement tenant-safe session-affinity objects and route-level rotation policies; expose admin metrics.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Prompt caching and provider beta passthrough/allowlist behavior.
capabilities.target_capability: Add prompt-cache control headers/fields only through provider adapters and contract tests.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: System-prompt modes: `--system-prompt=verbatim
capabilities.target_capability: aggressive

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: `--honor-client-thinking` / upstream honor-client-thinking env var: default rebuilds outbound request with CC thinking shape; opt-in preserves non-CC client's `thinking` block.
capabilities.target_capability: Add route-level `ThinkingPolicy` with default provider-compatible shaping and explicit opt-in pass-through, plus tests for preserving/removing client thinking blocks.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: OAuth lifecycle behavior from the external command surface: manual headless enrollment, logout/refresh/status/diagnostic/auth-check semantics.
capabilities.target_capability: Implement provider OAuth lifecycle as worker-safe Rust services using the owned secret-provider port for refresh-token handles; no browser automation runs in cluster.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Multi-account pool activates at 2+ accounts.
capabilities.target_capability: Existing pool foundation must gain external-reference-compatible activation/inspection semantics per tenant/provider.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Headroom selection: `1 - max(util_5h, util_7d)` including per-model future bucket parsing.
capabilities.target_capability: Implement provider metric parsers and normalized quota/headroom model; support external reference Anthropic headers plus provider-specific variants.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Session pinning/stickiness by hash of first user message, TTL/cap, rebinding on 429.
capabilities.target_capability: Add configurable sticky key strategy that never stores raw prompt text and preserves privacy.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: In-flight 429 failover to another account, account rejection/cache/cooldown, auth failure cooldown.
capabilities.target_capability: Implement failover state machine with lease release, retry budget, idempotency protection, and observability.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Token refresh singleflight and stale login resync.
capabilities.target_capability: Implement refresh worker/controller with singleflight locks and reconciliation status.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Non-loopback proxy requires API key; supports upstream proxy API-key env var, CORS, upstream proxy, strict TLS.
capabilities.target_capability: In cloud mode require tenant authn/authz/mTLS or API-key; expose CORS and upstream proxy only through policy-reviewed config.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Configuration precedence is deterministic in the pinned source reference; Oyatie must translate it to declarative cloud precedence with atomic config/status updates.
capabilities.target_capability: Implement typed declarative config layering with admission validation; add tests proving precedence, secret-source separation, and conflict diagnostics without adding a CLI layer.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Aider, Cline/Roo/Kilo, Continue.dev, Zed, OpenHands, OpenClaw, Codex-compatible client, Claude Agent SDK, and scripts.
capabilities.target_capability: Maintain executable compatibility matrix with supported/inferred/blocked states and canaries.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: 64/66-entry schema-verified TOOL_MAP for agent tool schemas.
capabilities.target_capability: Build typed `ToolCompatibilityProfile` registry and golden tests; do not hard-code one-off transforms in handlers.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Auto-detect text-tool clients, preserve tools, hybrid/merge tool modes, custom tool schema escape hatches.
capabilities.target_capability: Add explicit tool-mode policy and request classification tests; support preserve/hybrid/merge only when stable and audited.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Strips orchestration tags from messages.
capabilities.target_capability: Add sanitizer component with privacy/security tests and tenant-configurable policy.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Cursor public HTTPS tunnel guidance and `anthropic:` prefix workaround for SSRF/format gotchas.
capabilities.target_capability: Superset: document/implement cloud-safe external client profiles without recommending insecure tunnel defaults.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Deprecated/experimental shim mode: upstream shim transport patches `globalThis.fetch` in a Node/Bun child, has telemetry pipe, runtime detection, header-order replay, and `--priority=normal
capabilities.target_capability: low`.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: External local operator panel behavior: live request stream, per-model burn-rate, rate-limit utilization, billing-bucket breakdown, config editor.
capabilities.target_capability: Superset via cloud dashboard/admin API/Kubernetes status only; no CLI/TUI implementation and no hot-path dependency on UI.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Analytics records streaming/non-streaming usage, rate limits, account/provider data, request IDs, logs with redaction.
capabilities.target_capability: Reuse `llm.usage.v1`/`llm.audit.v1`; add external reference-equivalent route/account/model dimensions and redaction tests.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Overage guard halts proxy on Anthropic representative-claim overage; returns 503 until resume/cooldown; emits event/SSE/operator notifications.
capabilities.target_capability: Superset as `GatewayCircuitBreaker`/budget guard per tenant/provider/model with admin resume, events, and Retry-After.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Diagnostic/config/usage/upgrade/status behavior from the external command surface; structured diagnostic output.
capabilities.target_capability: Superset as admin API, Kubernetes health/diagnostic CR status, events, and cloud dashboard views only.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Read-only MCP server exposes doctor/status/accounts/backends/subagent/fingerprint tools; mutations excluded.
capabilities.target_capability: Optional ops MCP server with read-only tools backed by admin API, RBAC, and audit.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Claude Code subagent install/status/remove integration.
capabilities.target_capability: Superset as agent/client profile packaging, but keep installation outside gateway hot path.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Credentials redacted; bind loopback by default; no telemetry; strict permissions; body log redaction; no runtime deps claim.
capabilities.target_capability: Maintain stronger cloud defaults: owned secret-provider-only secrets, no prompt/body logging by default, redaction tests, signed SBOM/provenance.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: SSRF/proxy target allowlist: only supported provider paths are proxied.
capabilities.target_capability: Enforce provider/backend allowlists at config admission and request execution.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Docker/headless mode supports manual OAuth and secret files; `the upstream local persistence directory` persistence; healthcheck; Kubernetes single-replica example.
capabilities.target_capability: Superset with K8s Deployment/Service/HPA/PDB/NetworkPolicy, secret-provider adapter resources, and worker Deployments/CronJobs/Jobs.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: CI/quality posture: tests, CodeQL, SLSA, drift watchers, compatibility gates.
capabilities.target_capability: Add parity CI gate pinned to this baseline plus existing Oyatie governance gates.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Live capture/CC wire-shape replay and three drift classes: npm-release, remote-config, classifier-rule.
capabilities.target_capability: Implement pinned-baseline parity worker plus provider drift workers; all drift events produce audit evidence and PR/task output.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Compat/liveness gates before claiming support.
capabilities.target_capability: CI must require route matrix, client canaries, streaming fixtures, pool/failover, and security regression suites.

capabilities.source_behavior_summary: Upstream pinned source reference version pin is necessary for future parity.
capabilities.target_capability: Store `.omx/specs/external-proxy-reference-baseline-20260610.json`; future work reads it and emits delta.
